name: Scheduler

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'
  push:
    branches: [ master ]

jobs:
  update-sponsors:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6

      - name: Set node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: lts/*

      - run: pnpm i

      - name: Update sponsors
        run: npm run build
        env:
          SPONSORKIT_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SPONSORKIT_GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          SPONSORKIT_GITHUB_LOGIN: antfu
          SPONSORKIT_OPENCOLLECTIVE_KEY: ${{ secrets.SPONSORKIT_OPENCOLLECTIVE_KEY }}
          SPONSORKIT_OPENCOLLECTIVE_SLUG: antfu
          SPONSORKIT_AFDIAN_USER_ID: ${{ secrets.SPONSORKIT_AFDIAN_USER_ID }}
          SPONSORKIT_AFDIAN_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SPONSORKIT_AFDIAN_TOKEN }}

      - name: Commit
        uses: EndBug/add-and-commit@v9
        with:
          author_name: GitHub Actions
          author_email: 41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com
          message: 'chore: update sponsors.svg [ci skip]'
          add: "sponsors.*"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

name: Metrics
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 */2 * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
jobs:
  github-metrics:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Metrics
        uses: lowlighter/metrics@latest
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.METRICS_TOKEN }}

          # Options
          filename: metrics.svg
          user: antfu
          base: header, activity, repositories, metadata
          config_timezone: Asia/Shanghai
          config_twemoji: yes

        with:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

        with:

          cache: pnpm

      - name: Setup
        run: npm i -g @antfu/ni

      - name: Install
        run: nci

      - name: Typecheck
        run: nr typecheck

    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}

    strategy:

      - uses: actions/checkout@v5

        uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
